verdict.rationale: Clara documents pulling transactions via its API and an MCP server for reviewing transactions, and its reconciliation guide describes categorizing transactions with labels that attach GL codes, cost centers, or project IDs, so an agent can read transactions and write coding back. The evidence does not show filtering for uncoded transactions, policy-flag writing, or a review or approval step for agent-pushed coding. Missing for 10: an uncoded-transaction filter, policy flag/violation write-back, a documented review queue for agent-proposed coding, explicit label-write endpoints via MCP, and independent hands-on corroboration.
